locales.name: Spanish
locales.regional_target: LATAM (neutral); avoid rioplatense or Iberian-only constructions

locales.name: Japanese
locales.regional_target: Standard Japanese, business polite register (です/ます). Keep tech terms in English (Claude, MCP, RevOps). Numerals in Arabic digits.

locales.name: Russian
locales.regional_target: Standard Russian, formal "Вы" for B2B audience. Keep tech terms in Latin script (Claude, Apollo, MCP) — common practice in Russian B2B tech writing.

locales.name: Romanian
locales.regional_target: Standard Romanian, informal "tu" register (B2B/digital convention). Use diacritics correctly (ă, â, î, ș, ț). Keep tech terms in English.

locales.name: French
locales.regional_target: Metropolitan French (not Quebec). Formal "vous" for B2B audience. Anglicisms standard in tech (no need to force "courriel" for "email").

locales.name: German
locales.regional_target: Standard German (Bundesdeutsch). Formal "Sie" for B2B audience. Anglicisms standard in tech writing.

locales.name: Chinese (Simplified)
locales.regional_target: Mainland Simplified Chinese (not Traditional). Tech terms commonly stay in English (Claude, MCP, GitHub). Mainland vocabulary for shared terms (软件 not 軟體).

locales.name: Korean
locales.regional_target: Standard Korean, business register (-습니다/입니다). Tech terms in English/Latin script — Hangul + Latin mix is normal in Korean tech writing.

locales.name: Arabic
locales.regional_target: Modern Standard Arabic (فصحى) — not regional dialects (Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, Maghrebi). Tech terms in English/Latin script common in MSA tech writing.
